data.content_ref: inline:SRC_001 proposes a contradiction relation between SRC_004 and SRC_005, but the causal mechanism is under-specified: it asserts that activation patterns (software state) 'override' weight-distribution biases (hardware state) without identifying whether the override is causal (state suppressing bias-driven outputs) or merely descriptive (state selecting among bias-permitted outputs). The refutation condition only tests whether the critic persona fails on high-probability hallucination paths, but a failure there is equally compatible with the persona merely failing to select the correct path (no contradiction) as with the bias overriding the persona (contradiction). The relation cannot distinguish these.
